description: Example SpaCEy survival config with illustrative hyperparameters (not tuned for any dataset). Pass it with --params_json; its 'hyperparameters' override the command-line hyperparameters.
run: cd bin; python train_test_controller.py --dataset_name <DATASET> --en quick_start --folds_json <FOLDS_JSON> --params_json example_quick_config.json [--cv_setting heldout]
